# Independent review disposition — SCI-FRUIT v0.1 / r0.1

A fresh implementation-blind reviewer received only the eleven approved author inputs, permission/identity controls and new Stage B draft outputs. The reviewer did not inherit the author conversation, inspect implementation, follow unlisted sources, perform numerical work or inspect PDFs. Root separately performed artifact verification and every-page visual inspection.

| Substantive round | Finding and disposition |
| --- | --- |
| [Round 1](ROUND_1.md) | One low-severity omission, R1-01: carry forward the explicit independent-pointing evidence obligation for later numerical development, qualification and policy recommendations. All other reviewed scientific obligations were consistent. |
| [Round 2](ROUND_2.md) | R1-01 closed after restoring that inherited gate in the canonical authority and owner ledger. The evidence plan remains known-but-unsupplied. The final common-source snapshot and related records are bound by byte counts and SHA-256. No open scientific-consistency findings or newly unresolved owner premise. |

Two of the maximum three substantive rounds were used. No finding requires a third. The review closed for the source hashes recorded in round 2; the final artifact verifier checks those exact bytes.

The reviewer checked all twenty stable predictions, complete method obligations, model/type/reference/gauge/null-space conditions, linearity hierarchy, response scopes/composition/supersession, covariance/cross terms, support/origin, lifecycle/continuation/terminal/universal gates, and inherited producer/PTC/NOI/downstream boundaries. Detailed evidence and the actual read set are in the two reports.

This is advisory consistency review, not owner approval, conditional freeze, numerical qualification, implementation conformity or downstream fitness. The existing numerical questions remain deferred. Grant Wilson's separate Stage B review/conditional-freeze decision is pending.
